purpose: Survivorship-bias-reduced stress test on the DJIA constituent universe frozen at 2000-01

data.split_cleanup: common-factor overnight split detection; pre-split OHLCV back-adjusted

strategy.Track_B: production defaults frozen; no long-horizon tuning
strategy.management: TP1 30% => BE; TP2 30% => TP1; runner 40% confirmed 4H pivot

conservative_5r_cap.method: At most five simultaneous 1R positions; does not credit intratrade risk reduction.

limitations: Universe membership is frozen to the DJIA roster in effect at 2000-01; no later constituent replacements are added.
Corporate mergers, reorganizations, delistings and ticker reuse can complicate long-run security continuity in raw ticker data.
This reduces survivorship bias versus today's winners, but does not eliminate historical-data/corporate-action bias.
